page.overview:
What is Ambulator?

Ambulators were planeswalking devices first used by Phyrexians.

Using one was an unpleasant experience for mortals, similar to being taken along by a planeswalker. They had two ends, a prime end, and a secondary end, with each end planted on a different plane. Though the two ends functioned differently, the passage they created was two-way.

Xantcha regularly used Ambulators while she was still working for Phyrexia.

On Urborg, Venser subconsciously built a machine that mimicked his latent abilities using parts from leftover Phyrexian artifacts. Later, a modified version was built with the help of the Ghitu. Since Teferi lost his spark when he healed the Shivan rift, the artifact proved to be invaluable.
